output.reason: The brief makes a strong case through specific comparisons: the aps-3 cell that skipped the compaction push stayed normal, use-1 slowed only after the push and not when it got 5.8, and rolling euw-1 back to 5.7 changed nothing. The single-cell compaction revert it proposes is clear, though it doesn't say what drove the backlog growth, and with backlog close to the 15% threshold the revert carries some risk.
